alex_csm: Need a concise "go-live-ready" one-sheet for customers
head of their launch. Focus: prefills, batching, streaming tradeoffs, and clear renewal-risk signals.
tina_eng: Keep it to a single checklist + two small copy-paste blocks: one YAML for infra, one set of Console queries for the AM.
lee_sre: Add quick operational caveats about streaming connections and memory; also include an ordered troubleshooting list for oncall.
nina_cs: Customers want a one-line approval they can paste into a calendar invite and a post-priming micro-survey.
alex_csm: Draft outline Im aiming for: 1) 6-step customer checklist 2) infra snippet 3) monitoring queries 4) escalation thresholds & cadence 5) micro-survey + AM script.
tina_eng: YAML snippet (for infra teams):
tina_eng: ```yaml
launch_priming:
  enabled: true
  sample_flows: 30
  warm_instances: 3
serving:
  batching:
    mode: adaptive
    max_requests: 5
    max_tokens: 512
  streaming: prefer
  cache:
    prefix_ttl_seconds: 420
```
lee_sre: Customer checklist (copy/paste):
1) Confirm model is pinned to an exact version + quantization profile.
2) Grant service account inference:invoke and metrics:read.
3) Approve a 30-45 minute priming window.
4) Run priming: sample ~30 representative flows (include long prefixes).
5) Maintain warm_instances >= 2 for first 3 hours after launch.
6) Execute 5 golden transactions and report latency & any surprising completions.
nina_cs: One-line customer consent to paste: "Please approve a 30-45 minute priming run to warm model instances and cache common prefixes so early users see faster responses."
tina_eng: Monitoring queries (paste into Console / dashboard):
tina_eng: ```query
sum(rate(inference_errors_total{tenant="${tenant}"}[5m])) as errors_5m
avg_over_time(latency_ms{model="${model}"}[5m]) as avg_latency_5m
percentile_over_time(latency_ms{model="${model}"}[5m], 95) as p95_5m
success_rate(prompt_set="golden", window=1h) as golden_success_1h
```
lee_sre: Escalation thresholds we recommend (configurable per-customer):
- Infra: errors > 4x baseline sustained for 10m -> page #eng-oncall and open ticket with tag onboarding:urgent.
- Quality: golden_success_rate drops >= 35% versus baseline over 1h -> notify AM + create triage ticket.
- Perf: avg_latency >= 2.5x baseline for 20m -> run fallback (route % to smaller model) and page oncall.
lee_sre: Suggested cadence for renewal-risk play: 24-48h check after launch, 7-day regression lookback, if unresolved after 72h escalate to Solutions Eng and propose a temporary slowdown of expansion.
tina_eng: Troubleshooting, in order (copyable to runbook):
1) Confirm model pin & revert to prior if quality regressed.
2) Check warm_instance count and that prefill/sample job completed.
3) If tail latency high -> reduce batching.max_requests or increase batching window_ms.
4) If streaming connection errors -> lower max concurrent streams or toggle streaming=false.
5) If errors persist -> route a small percentage to a known-good fallback model and collect traces.
nina_cs: Post-priming micro-survey (one-click style):
Subject: "Priming complete  quick check"
Body: "Please run 5 representative flows and reply: 1) Outputs matched expectations? (Yes/No) 2) Avg latency observed (ms) 3) Any errors/timeouts or unusual completions?"
alex_csm: 30s AM script to request priming approval (pasteable):
"We'd like a 30-45 minute window to send short, representative traffic to warm model instances and cache common prefixes. This reduces cold-start latency for your initial users. Approve?"
tina_eng: Automation hooks to add to runbooks: auto-create ticket + tag onboarding:high-risk when alerts fire; include golden prompt diff attachments and avg latency trends in the ticket body.
opsbot: Internal note: priming-job template created at /ops/templates/launch-ready-priming.yaml :white_check_mark:
lee_sre: Final note: for very low-traffic customers prefer smaller batch sizes and shorter cache TTLs to keep per-request latency consistent; batching and caching are levers for cost vs latency tradeoffs.
nina_cs: i'll format into a single-page PDF and the AM email snippets. tagging @tina_eng and @lee_sre for technical sign-off.
alex_csm: thanks team  please review by EOD tomorrow, i'll post the final one-pager after sign-off.
